content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "Yes: the judge resolves the Matthew 1:16 clash by saying no cited text states the contrary in its own words, which is the retired stating-verse test rather than chain-against-chain footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the verb change is real [L1]/[L2] but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together: (1) the defender's multiple cited verses in [CR2] section A.3 and [CR3] are a chain read together, so K-C applies; or (2) they are isolated verses, so a verse-by-verse stating test is allowed.", "why": "The judge declares the link underdetermined because no cited text's own words state the contrary, which is precisely the verse-by-verse stating-verse test K-C retires instead of weighing the defender's cited chain by footing."}
